mapper.select: /* selectQesitmQustnbMngList - Song.Tae.soo */ SELECT A.QESITM_MNG_NO , A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO , A.QESITM_SQNCE , A.CHTY_QESITM_YN , A.CHTY_QESITM_ESNTAL_NO , A.CHTY_QESITM_RSPNS_VALUE , B.QESITM_CN , B.QESITM_DSCRP_CN , B.QESITM_TYPE_SE_CD , B.ESNTL_YN , B.USE_YN FROM SBB300 A JOIN SBB200 B ON A.QESITM_MNG_NO = B.QESITM_MNG_NO WHERE A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = #{QUSTNB_MNG_NO} ORDER BY A.QESITM_SQNCE ASC

/* selectQesitmQustnbCheckList - Song.Tae.soo */ SELECT QUSTNB_MNG_NO , QUSTNB_RELM_MNG_NO , QUSTNB_RELM_ESNTAL_NM , QUSTNB_BGNG_QESITM_NO , QUSTNB_END_QESITM_NO FROM SBB120 WHERE QUSTNB_MNG_NO = #{QUSTNB_MNG_NO}

/* selectQuestnbRelmBaseList - Song.Tae.soo */ SELECT A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO , A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO , A.QUSTNB_RELM_MNG_NO , A.QUSTNB_RELM_ESNTAL_NM AS QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM , A.QUSTNB_BGNG_QESITM_NO , A.QUSTNB_END_QESITM_NO , A.FRST_RGTR_ID , A.FRST_REG_DT , A.LAST_MDFR_ID , A.LAST_MDFCN_DT , B.USER_SRVY_RELM_INDCT_YN , B.MNGR_SRVY_RELM_INDCT_YN FROM SBB120 A LEFT JOIN SBB130 B ON A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_MNG_NO WHERE A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = #{QUSTNB_MNG_NO}

/* selectQuestnbRelmList - Song.Tae.soo */ SELECT QUSTNB_MNG_NO , QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO , QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_MNG_NO , QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM , QUSTNB_BGNG_QESITM_NO , QUSTNB_END_QESITM_NO , GRDNG_CRTR_SE_CD , USER_SRVY_RELM_INDCT_YN , MNGR_SRVY_RELM_INDCT_YN , FRST_RGTR_ID , FRST_REG_DT , LAST_MDFR_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT FROM SBB130 WHERE QUSTNB_MNG_NO = #{QUSTNB_MNG_NO}

/* selectResultCrtrList - Song.Tae.soo */ SELECT A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO , A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO , A.QUSTNB_RELM_MNG_NO , A.QUSTNB_RELM_ESNTAL_NM , A.QUSTNB_BGNG_QESITM_NO , A.QUSTNB_END_QESITM_NO , B.GRDNG_RESULT_CRTR_MNG_NO , B.QUSTNB_RELM_MNG_NO , B.GRDNG_RELM_SE_CD , B.GRDNG_RELM_SE_NM , B.BGNG_SCORE , B.END_SCORE , B.RESULT_CRTR_SE_CD FROM SBB400 B JOIN SBB120 A ON A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_MNG_NO AND A.QUSTNB_RELM_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_RELM_MNG_NO WHERE A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = #{QUSTNB_MNG_NO}

/* selectResultQustnbRelm - Song.Tae.soo */ SELECT QUSTNB_MNG_NO , QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO , QUSTNB_RELM_MNG_NO , QUSTNB_RELM_ESNTAL_NM , QUSTNB_BGNG_QESITM_NO , QUSTNB_END_QESITM_NO FROM SBB120 WHERE QUSTNB_MNG_NO = #{QUSTNB_MNG_NO}

/* selectQustnbMngInfo - Song.Tae.soo */ /* 20230511 이승재- 설문 재발송시 SBB600에 MNG_SN이 두개 등록되어 설문조회 에러. 그에따라 SBB600 LEFT JOIN을 아래와같이 변경함.*/ SELECT A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO , A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS TASKWK_SYS_SE_CD , A.QUSTNB_NM , A.SRVY_PURPS_CN , A.SRVY_WRT_GUIDAN_CN , A.SRVY_BGNG_YMD , A.SRVY_END_YMD , A.SRVY_TRGT_SE_CD , A.SRVY_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD , A.WRTR_ID , C##RG.DEC_B64(A.WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT , C##RG.DEC_B64(B.SRVY_RSPDNT_NM_ENCPT) AS SRVY_RSPDNT_NM FROM SBB100 A LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SRVY_ERA_SE_CD , QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO , QUSTNB_MNG_NO , UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD , INST_NO , SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO , SRVY_RSPDNT_NM_ENCPT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY INST_NO, TRPR_INFO_NO, QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO, SRVY_ERA_SE_CD ORDER BY REG_YMD DESC, MNG_SN DESC) AS RN FROM SBB600 )B ON A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO AND A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_MNG_NO AND B.RN = 1 WHERE 1=1
AND A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = #{QUSTNB_MNG_NO}

/* selectPreSurvshtList - Song.Tae.soo */ SELECT B.QESITM_MNG_NO , B.QUSTNB_MNG_NO , B.QESITM_SQNCE , B.CHTY_QESITM_YN , B.CHTY_QESITM_ESNTAL_NO , B.CHTY_QESITM_RSPNS_VALUE , C.QESITM_CN , C.QESITM_DSCRP_CN , C.QESITM_TYPE_SE_CD , C.ESNTL_YN , C.USE_YN FROM SBB100 A JOIN SBB300 B ON A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_MNG_NO JOIN SBB200 C ON B.QESITM_MNG_NO = C.QESITM_MNG_NO AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = #{QUSTNB_MNG_NO} ORDER BY B.QESITM_SQNCE ASC

/* selectPreSurvshtDtlList - Song.Tae.soo */ SELECT D.QESITM_MNG_NO , D.SRVY_QESITM_EXMPL_MNG_NO , D.SRVY_QESITM_EXMPL_CN , D.SRVY_QESITM_EXMPL_SCORE , D.SRVY_QESITM_EXMPL_SQNCE FROM SBB100 A JOIN SBB300 B ON A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_MNG_NO JOIN SBB200 C ON B.QESITM_MNG_NO = C.QESITM_MNG_NO AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' JOIN SBB210 D ON D.QESITM_MNG_NO = C.QESITM_MNG_NO WHERE A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = #{QUSTNB_MNG_NO} ORDER BY D.SRVY_QESITM_EXMPL_SQNCE ASC

SELECT A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO , A.QUSTNB_RELM_MNG_NO , A.QUSTNB_RELM_ESNTAL_NM , A.QUSTNB_BGNG_QESITM_NO , A.QUSTNB_END_QESITM_NO , A.MNGR_MNG_PRVSON_YN , B.GRDNG_CRTR_SE_CD , B.USER_SRVY_RELM_INDCT_YN , B.MNGR_SRVY_RELM_INDCT_YN FROM SBB120 A LEFT JOIN SBB130 B ON A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_MNG_NO AND A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO AND A.QUSTNB_BGNG_QESITM_NO = B.QUSTNB_BGNG_QESITM_NO AND A.QUSTNB_END_QESITM_NO = B.QUSTNB_END_QESITM_NO WHERE A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = #{QUSTNB_MNG_NO}

/* selectSrvyTrprList - Song.Tae.soo */ SELECT (A.CASE_MNG_NO || '_' || A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO || '_' || C##RG.DEC_B64(B.TRPR_NM_ENCPT)) AS TRPR_NM , (A.CASE_MNG_NO || '_' || A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO || '_' || C##RG.DEC_B64(B.TRPR_NM_ENCPT)) AS TRPR_INFO_NO FROM SEB100 A JOIN SEA200 B ON A.TRPR_INFO_NO = B.TRPR_INFO_NO

/* selectTrprInfoDtl - Song.Tae.soo */ SELECT A.CASE_MNG_NO , A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO , A.TRPR_INFO_NO , A.CASE_BGNG_YMD , A.CASE_TRMN_YMD , A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS TASKWK_SYS_SE_CD , A.GOAL_PLAN_CN , A.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD , A.TAG_NM , A.TAG_NO , B.TRPR_NM_ENCPT AS CASE_TRPR_NM_ENCPT , B.CASE_TRPR_TYPE_SE_CD , C##RG.DEC_B64(B.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO , B.SXDC_SE_CD FROM SEB100 A JOIN SEA200 B ON A.TRPR_INFO_NO = B.TRPR_INFO_NO WHERE A.CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO}

/* selectStatusQustnbMng - Song.Tae.soo */ SELECT CASE WHEN (TO_date(A.SRVY_END_YMD, 'YYYY/MM/DD') > SYSDATE ) THEN 'FAIL' ELSE 'PASS' END AS END_DATE_CHK , CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SBB500 B WHERE A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_MNG_NO) > 0 THEN 'FAIL' ELSE 'PASS' END AS RSPNS_CHK FROM SBB100 A WHERE A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = #{QUSTNB_MNG_NO}

/* selectSurvshtTmptCpList - Song.Tae.soo */
SELECT A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO, A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS TASKWK_SYS_SE_CD, A.QUSTNB_TMPT_NM, A.QUSTNB_NM, A.SRVY_PURPS_CN, A.SRVY_WRT_GUIDAN_CN, A.SRVY_BGNG_YMD, A.SRVY_END_YMD, A.SRVY_TRGT_SE_CD, A.USE_YN, (CASE A.USE_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN '사용' ELSE '미사용' END) AS USE_YN_NM, A.SRVY_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD, (SELECT D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 D WHERE D.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SRVY_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD' AND D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.SRVY_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD ) AS SRVY_PRGRS_STTS_SE_NM, A.FRST_RGTR_ID, TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS FRST_REG_DT, A.LAST_MDFR_ID, TO_CHAR(A.LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LAST_MDFCN_DT FROM SBB000 A /* 설문지 */ WHERE 1=1 AND USE_YN = 'Y'
AND (A.QUSTNB_TMPT_NM LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_DATA}||'%' OR A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_DATA}||'%' OR A.SRVY_PURPS_CN LIKE '%'||#{SEARCH_DATA}||'%')
AND A.QUSTNB_TMPT_NM LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_DATA} || '%'
AND A.QUSTNB_NM LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_DATA} || '%'
AND A.SRVY_PURPS_CN LIKE '%' || #{SEARCH_DATA} || '%'
AND A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD}
ORDER BY A.FRST_REG_DT DESC

/* selectQesitmQustnbTmptMngList - Song.Tae.soo */ SELECT A.QESITM_MNG_NO , A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO , A.QESITM_SQNCE , A.CHTY_QESITM_YN , A.CHTY_QESITM_ESNTAL_NO , A.CHTY_QESITM_RSPNS_VALUE , B.QESITM_CN , B.QESITM_DSCRP_CN , B.QESITM_TYPE_SE_CD , B.ESNTL_YN , B.USE_YN FROM SBB010 A JOIN SBB200 B ON A.QESITM_MNG_NO = B.QESITM_MNG_NO WHERE A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = #{QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO} ORDER BY A.QESITM_SQNCE ASC

/* selectQesitmQustnbTmptCheckList - Song.Tae.soo */ SELECT QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO , QUSTNB_RELM_MNG_NO , QUSTNB_RELM_ESNTAL_NM , QUSTNB_BGNG_QESITM_NO , QUSTNB_END_QESITM_NO , MNGR_MNG_PRVSON_YN FROM SBB020 WHERE QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = #{QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO}

/* selectResultCrtrTmptList - Song.Tae.soo */ SELECT A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO , A.QUSTNB_RELM_MNG_NO , A.QUSTNB_RELM_ESNTAL_NM , A.QUSTNB_BGNG_QESITM_NO , A.QUSTNB_END_QESITM_NO , B.GRDNG_RESULT_CRTR_MNG_NO , B.QUSTNB_RELM_MNG_NO , B.GRDNG_RELM_SE_CD , B.GRDNG_RELM_SE_NM , B.BGNG_SCORE , B.END_SCORE , B.RESULT_CRTR_SE_CD FROM SBB040 B JOIN SBB020 A ON A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO AND A.QUSTNB_RELM_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_RELM_MNG_NO WHERE A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = #{QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO}

/* selectQuestnbRelmBaseTmptList - Song.Tae.soo */ SELECT A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO , A.QUSTNB_RELM_MNG_NO , A.QUSTNB_RELM_ESNTAL_NM AS QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM , A.QUSTNB_BGNG_QESITM_NO , A.QUSTNB_END_QESITM_NO , A.MNGR_MNG_PRVSON_YN , A.FRST_RGTR_ID , A.FRST_REG_DT , A.LAST_MDFR_ID , A.LAST_MDFCN_DT , NVL(B.USER_SRVY_RELM_INDCT_YN,'Y') AS USER_SRVY_RELM_INDCT_YN , NVL(B.MNGR_SRVY_RELM_INDCT_YN,'Y') AS MNGR_SRVY_RELM_INDCT_YN FROM SBB020 A LEFT JOIN SBB030 B ON A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO WHERE A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = #{QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO}

/* selectQuestnbRelmList - Song.Tae.soo */ SELECT QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO , QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO , QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_MNG_NO , QUSTNB_GRDNG_RELM_ESNTAL_NM , QUSTNB_BGNG_QESITM_NO , QUSTNB_END_QESITM_NO , GRDNG_CRTR_SE_CD , FRST_RGTR_ID , FRST_REG_DT , LAST_MDFR_ID , LAST_MDFCN_DT , USER_SRVY_RELM_INDCT_YN , MNGR_SRVY_RELM_INDCT_YN FROM SBB030 WHERE QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = #{QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO}

/* selectResultQustnbRelmTmpt - Song.Tae.soo */ SELECT QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO , QUSTNB_RELM_MNG_NO , QUSTNB_RELM_ESNTAL_NM , QUSTNB_BGNG_QESITM_NO , QUSTNB_END_QESITM_NO FROM SBB020 WHERE QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = #{QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO}

/* selectQustnbMngTmptInfo - Song.Tae.soo */ SELECT QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO , UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS TASKWK_SYS_SE_CD , QUSTNB_NM , SRVY_PURPS_CN , SRVY_WRT_GUIDAN_CN , SRVY_BGNG_YMD , SRVY_END_YMD , SRVY_TRGT_SE_CD , SRVY_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD , WRTR_ID , C##RG.DEC_B64(WRTR_NM_ENCPT) AS WRTR_NM_ENCPT FROM SBB000 WHERE QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = #{QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO}

/* selectPreSurvshtTmptList - Song.Tae.soo */ SELECT B.QESITM_MNG_NO , B.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO , B.QESITM_SQNCE , B.CHTY_QESITM_YN , B.CHTY_QESITM_ESNTAL_NO , B.CHTY_QESITM_RSPNS_VALUE , C.QESITM_CN , C.QESITM_DSCRP_CN , C.QESITM_TYPE_SE_CD , C.ESNTL_YN , C.USE_YN FROM SBB000 A JOIN SBB010 B ON A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO JOIN SBB200 C ON B.QESITM_MNG_NO = C.QESITM_MNG_NO AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = #{QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO} ORDER BY B.QESITM_SQNCE ASC

/* selectPreSurvshtDtlTmptList - Song.Tae.soo */ SELECT D.QESITM_MNG_NO , D.SRVY_QESITM_EXMPL_MNG_NO , D.SRVY_QESITM_EXMPL_CN , D.SRVY_QESITM_EXMPL_SCORE , D.SRVY_QESITM_EXMPL_SQNCE FROM SBB000 A JOIN SBB010 B ON A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO JOIN SBB200 C ON B.QESITM_MNG_NO = C.QESITM_MNG_NO AND C.USE_YN = 'Y' JOIN SBB210 D ON D.QESITM_MNG_NO = C.QESITM_MNG_NO WHERE A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = #{QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO} ORDER BY D.SRVY_QESITM_EXMPL_SQNCE ASC

/* selectPreSurvshtDtlTmptRelmList - Song Tae.soo */ SELECT QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO , QUSTNB_RELM_MNG_NO , QUSTNB_RELM_ESNTAL_NM , QUSTNB_BGNG_QESITM_NO , QUSTNB_END_QESITM_NO FROM SBB020 WHERE QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = #{QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO}

/* selectQustnbTmptMngNoInfo - Song.Tae.soo */ SELECT A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO, A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS TASKWK_SYS_SE_CD, A.QUSTNB_TMPT_NM, A.QUSTNB_NM, A.SRVY_PURPS_CN, A.SRVY_WRT_GUIDAN_CN, A.SRVY_BGNG_YMD, A.SRVY_END_YMD, A.SRVY_TRGT_SE_CD, A.USE_YN, (CASE A.USE_YN WHEN 'Y' THEN '사용' ELSE '미사용' END) AS USE_YN_NM, A.SRVY_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD, (SELECT D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 D WHERE D.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SRVY_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD' AND D.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.SRVY_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD ) AS SRVY_PRGRS_STTS_SE_NM, A.FRST_RGTR_ID, TO_CHAR(A.FRST_REG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS FRST_REG_DT, A.LAST_MDFR_ID, TO_CHAR(A.LAST_MDFCN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS LAST_MDFCN_DT FROM SBB000 A /* 설문지 */ WHERE A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = #{QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO}

/* selectSurvshtQesitmTmptList - Song.Tae.soo */ SELECT A.QESITM_MNG_NO , A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO , A.QESITM_SQNCE , A.CHTY_QESITM_YN , A.CHTY_QESITM_ESNTAL_NO , A.CHTY_QESITM_RSPNS_VALUE , B.QESITM_CN , B.QESITM_DSCRP_CN , B.QESITM_TYPE_SE_CD , B.ESNTL_YN , B.USE_YN FROM SBB010 A JOIN SBB200 B ON A.QESITM_MNG_NO = B.QESITM_MNG_NO WHERE A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = #{QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO} ORDER BY A.QESITM_SQNCE ASC

/* selectMySurvshtList - Song.Tae.soo */ SELECT A.QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO , A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO , A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS TASKWK_SYS_SE_CD , A.QUSTNB_TMPT_NM , A.QUSTNB_NM , A.SRVY_PURPS_CN , A.SRVY_WRT_GUIDAN_CN , A.SRVY_BGNG_YMD , A.SRVY_END_YMD , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.SRVY_BGNG_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') || '~' || TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.SRVY_END_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SRVY_YMD , A.SRVY_TRGT_SE_CD , (SELECT F.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 F WHERE F.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SRVY_TRGT_SE_CD' AND F.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.SRVY_TRGT_SE_CD) AS SRVY_TRGT_SE_NM , A.SRVY_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD , (SELECT F.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 F WHERE F.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SRVY_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD' AND F.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.SRVY_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD) AS SRVY_PRGRS_STTS_SE_NM , B.CASE_MNG_NO , B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO , C##RG.DEC_B64(B.CASE_TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS CASE_TRPR_NM FROM SBB100 A JOIN SBB110 B ON A.QUSTNB_MNG_NO = B.QUSTNB_MNG_NO WHERE A.SRVY_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD = '06' /* 설문완료 */ ORDER BY B.FRST_REG_DT DESC

SELECT QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO , QUSTNB_RELM_MNG_NO , QUSTNB_RELM_NOMFRM_SN , GRDNG_RELM_SE_CD , SXDC_SE_CD , NOMFRM_VALUE1 , NOMFRM_VALUE2 , USE_YN FROM SBB620 WHERE QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO = #{QUSTNB_TMPT_MNG_NO}
